title: Retry traffic for an interrupted 500 MiB upload
method: Synthetic ten-part file: 10 × 50 MiB = 500 MiB. Failure occurs after nine complete parts and before any useful tenth-part bytes. Restart: 450 + 500 = 950 MiB; resume: 450 + 50 = 500 MiB. Excludes transport and request overhead.
alt: Retry traffic for an interrupted 500 MiB upload. Restart whole file: 950 MiB transferred; Resume final part: 500 MiB transferred. Illustrative inputs.
